$comment: The XR frame record (docs/spec/09, XRF-1..7): one block of native memory the XR thread writes before each
XR frame and JS (web/xr + IWER host mode) reads in place through typed-array views. This file is the single
definition (XRF-4); gen/generate-layout.mjs turns it into include/iwn/xr/frame_record_layout.gen.h (C++ byte
offsets) and web/xr/src/layout.gen.ts (typed-array element indices). Bump `version` whenever an existing
offset changes; adding fields at the end of a type group without moving others still needs a bump, because
the generator orders groups by element size (f64, then 4-byte fields in declaration order, then u8).
perHand fields appear twice: left first, then right (HOST-INPUT.md order).
name: XRHostFrameRecord

fields.name: layoutVersion
fields.doc: this file's version; JS refuses a record whose version differs (XRF-4)

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: bit 0 shouldRender, bit 1 baseIsStage

fields.name: viewCount
fields.doc: 1 or 2

fields.name: colorTexture
fields.doc: GL name of the swapchain image acquired for this frame, 0 when none

fields.name: frameSerial
fields.doc: increments for every frame handed to JS

fields.name: imageArraySize
fields.doc: 1 (side by side) or 2 (texture array) for the current swapchain, 0 when none

fields.name: sceneSerial
fields.doc: XRF-7: increments when the detected planes or meshes changed

fields.name: depthTexture
fields.doc: XR-DEPTH-1 reserve: depth swapchain image, 0 today

fields.name: motionTexture
fields.doc: XR_FB_space_warp reserve: motion-vector image, 0 today

fields.name: predictedDisplayTime
fields.doc: OpenXR predicted display time on the performance.now() clock, ms, strictly increasing (XR-LOOP-5)

fields.name: frameStartTime
fields.doc: when xrWaitFrame returned, performance.now() ms: window rAF time (TMR-5) and open question 12

fields.name: displayPeriod
fields.doc: predicted display period, ms

fields.name: frameRate
fields.doc: current display refresh rate, Hz (0 unknown)

fields.name: foveation
fields.doc: fixed foveation in effect, 0..1

fields.name: viewportScale
fields.doc: XRF-7 reserve: recommended viewport scale per view (1 today)

fields.name: views
fields.doc: per view: position xyz, orientation xyzw, fov angleLeft angleRight angleUp angleDown (radians), base space

fields.name: localPose
fields.doc: OpenXR LOCAL origin in the base space: xyz, xyzw

fields.name: viewerPose
fields.doc: OpenXR VIEW space pose in the base space (IWER derives the head from the eyes today)

fields.name: gazePose
fields.doc: XRF-7 reserve: eye-gaze pose

fields.name: inputMode
fields.doc: XRHostInputMode: 0 none, 1 controller, 2 hand

fields.name: inputFlags
fields.doc: bit 0 targetRayValid, bit 1 gripValid, bit 2 palmValid

fields.name: inputProfile
fields.doc: native interaction profile id (src/core/input_map.h InputProfile)

fields.name: targetRay
fields.doc: aim pose, base space

fields.name: grip
fields.doc: grip pose, base space

fields.name: palm
fields.doc: palm pose (hands), base space

fields.name: buttonValues
fields.doc: gamepad index order of the current mode

fields.name: axes
fields.doc: touchpad x y, thumbstick x y; +x right, +y toward the user

fields.name: joints
fields.doc: 25 WebXR joints x (xyz, xyzw, radius)
